fields.System.Title: RPL-301 — Assign a replenishment task
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a replenishment operator, I want to be given the next replenishment job, so that I
work the highest-priority refill rather than picking one at random.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given open tasks, when I request work, then one is assigned and locked to me.
  • - Given tasks with different priorities, then wave-blocking tasks are issued first.
  • - Given several operators requesting simultaneously, then each task goes to exactly one
  • of them.
  • - Given a task assigned to someone else, then I cannot confirm it.
  • - Given an abandoned task, then it returns to the pool after the configured timeout.
